candidates.title: App shell layout
candidates.request: A common shell that holds a brand, global actions and a reserved place for navigation across screens.
candidates.summary: A centered 960px column with .app-header (brand left, .app-header-actions right holding a .app-nav slot and the primary action) and .app-main for screen content, separated by a hairline border. Implemented once, across the whole app, but the census recorded no shell/layout role; it is a provisional direction, not authority.
promote_when: a second distinct surface mounts into app-main and reuses the header/nav slot (for example a settings or search screen), giving the census a second compatible opportunity; then codify as a pattern artifact.

tests: resolve: overall app shell layout header navigation -> UNDEFINED + candidate/app-shell

candidates.title: Per-card action group
candidates.request: A trailing group of per-row actions on a collection card (edit and delete), with a narrow-width layout that keeps them visible.
candidates.summary: Each .bookmark-card ends with a .bookmark-actions group holding a small ghost Edit and a small danger-ghost Delete, right-aligned on desktop and wrapped to its own full-width right-aligned row behind a hairline divider at phone width. The delete trigger is codified by pattern/destructive; the group layout itself has no census role and stays provisional.
promote_when: a second collection surface reuses the same trailing action group (for example search results with share/duplicate), or the census records a per-row-actions role across two opportunities; then codify as a pattern artifact.

tests: resolve: per bookmark edit and delete actions on each card -> candidate/card-actions
